title: [AUDIT-R1-06] Preserve Session start results after cleanup failure
body: 来源：实际Claude Sonnet5.5 round1 finding6，候选635be2a7。handleSessionStart finally的清理异常覆盖已提交结果且跳过activeRuns清理。由线程B核实与修复，独立小提交/PR，保留租约和未知义务，不增迁移。验收：真实DB/RPC故障测试、active_runs清零但execution_lease_holds保留、重放不重复启动。它是审计修复任务，不计作Firstmate新增能力，也不改写冻结50工作包。

title: [AUDIT-R3-H6] Require Session terminal completion before releasing execution
body: Confirmed host-boundary counterexample: registered Session adapter ends its iterator without terminal; send returns agent_failed but releases, start records success and releases. Deterministic real SQLite/RPC/lock probe shows confirmStopped false was never consulted. Implement a separate narrow fix for start/send: incomplete terminal protocol is not settled proof; confirm stop or retain. No operator recovery API or per-turn stop-proof redesign. Red/green regressions and parent full tests + Sonnet 5.5 required. Evidence: firstmate-batch1-20261026/thread-b-round3-hypotheses.md. This is an audit defect, not a new roadmap feature.
